_meta.description: On-farm feed replacement value of a downgraded pulse harvest, for the mixed crop-livestock persona. Valuing a downgraded lot at the feed SPOT price understates it: a farm that feeds its own pulses replaces both purchased protein meal and purchased cereal, and avoids the haulage and trader margin on both.
_meta.method: 1 t of pulse substitutes a_soymeal tonnes of soybean meal plus a_cereal tonnes of feed wheat, on a combined crude-protein and metabolisable-energy equivalence basis.
_meta.source: Substitution ratios consistent with published French monogastric and ruminant ration formulation guidance (Terres Univia / Idele feed value tables).
_meta.caution: Real substitution is capped by anti-nutritional factors: raw pulses are limited to roughly 15-25 percent of a monogastric ration depending on species, and whole soybean needs heat treatment.

soybean.note: Requires toasting or extrusion to deactivate trypsin inhibitors; the cost of that treatment is not netted off here.
